His medical background encompasses hypertension and hypercholesterolaemia, treated with amlodipine, atorvastatin, and simvastatin. Unrelated to the current urological focus, he had uncomplicated cataract extraction in 2018, recently visited a sleep clinic for suspected obstructive sleep apnoea, and maintains routine podiatry appointments for foot care.
